channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
item.description: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

item.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
item.description: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

item.title: U.S. court blocks Trump bid to curb mail-in ballots
item.description: District Court Judge Indira Talwani wrote on Thursday (August 27) that it was "practically impossible" for states to comply with the "likely unconstitutional regulation," pointing out that the midterms were little over two months away. U. S. court blocks Trump bid to curb mail-in ballots.

item.title: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo spreads to two new health zones with total of 60 areas now affected
item.description: The two new zones affected are Biena and Manguredjipa in Congo's North Kivu Province, where the case fatality rate is much higher than the overall rate of 48%, due in part to delayed response efforts, according to Congo's Ministry of Health data Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo spreads to two new health zones with total of 60 areas now affected.

item.title: Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages
item.description: An "all-Russian" MC-21 passenger jet made its first test flight in early August, marking a step closer to full production, due to begin in 2027. But years of geopolitical turbulence have pushed the project far off-course, aviation insiders say. Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages.

item.title: PM Modi to undertake four-day visit to Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan
item.description: PM Modi will also hold bilateral meetings with SCO leaders on the sidelines of the summit; it is learnt that Vladimir Putin will be among the leaders with whom the PM will hold bilateral meetings PM Modi to undertake four-day visit to Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan.

item.title: Who counts as ‘foreign’ in Indonesia’s deepening China ties?
item.description: When China’s Defense Minister Admiral Dong Jun visited Jakarta on August 21, he and Indonesia’s Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin agreed to deepen military cooperation. At a joint press conference, Dong said Indonesia and China would work together against the “malicious intentions” of foreign powers. The two countries also agreed to expand defense cooperation.

item.title: India, Canada reiterate commitment to complete trade deal by end of 2026
item.description: A joint statement, issued by the Finance Ministers of both countries following the conclusion of the inaugural India-Canada Finance Ministers’ Economic and Financial Dialogue in Toronto, said that India had expressed its readiness to begin negotiations on a Bilateral Investment Treaty “at the earliest” India, Canada reiterate commitment to complete trade deal by end of 2026.

item.title: Please don’t rearrange our shoes when we turn up, paramedics in Japan urge
item.description: It is polite to reposition a guest’s shoes when they arrive, but the emergency services in one city advise just skipping that partEtiquette, manners and consideration for others are integral pillars of Japanese society but there are times when they might go a step too far, according to one city’s emergency services. Please don’t rearrange our shoes when we turn up, paramedics in Japan urge.

item.title: What could Meta’s US settlement mean around the world – and what now for other claims against firm?
item.description: Other governments could seek similar concessions, while separate legal action is pending in places ranging from Kenya to the NetherlandsIn October 2021, Abrham Meareg’s father, a professor of chemistry in Ethiopia’s northern town of Bahir Dar, was shot at close range and died outside his family home. This was in the middle of the country’s civil war. What could Meta’s US settlement mean around the world – and what now for other claims against firm?

item.title: Trump Dismisses Fears Of Russian Strike On NATO After CIA Chief Visits Moscow
item.description: US President Donald Trump told reporters that he does not believe Moscow will attack a NATO nation amid rising concerns that Russian President Vladimir Putin will strike a Baltic country or other member state to test the Western alliance’s resolve. Trump Dismisses Fears of Russian Strike On NATO After CIA Chief Visits Moscow.

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village
item.description: After a Ukrainian drone operator spotted an SOS sign outside a destroyed home in the Donetsk region, a three-day rescue mission was launched to save a couple who were the last remaining residents of their frontline village. Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village.

item.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
item.description: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Tracking Syria’s transition
item.description: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges. UN News app users can follow here.

item.title: Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster
item.description: Amid reports that hundreds of people are still missing in Nepal and China after a floodwater surge slammed into towns and villages on Wednesday, aid teams have been working to reach communities cut off by the disaster. Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster.

item.title: Latvia’s ‘Weekend Warriors’ Prepare For Potential Russian Threat
item.description: Latvia’s volunteer National Guard, the Zemessardze, has taken on a growing role in the country’s defense since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Following ordinary Latvians as they take part in military exercises, Current Time looks at why they give up their weekends to train. Latvia’s ‘Weekend Warriors’ Prepare For Potential Russian Threat.

item.title: Baltic States Arm For Russian Threat As Leaked Letter Shows Growing Fears
item.description: A letter seen by RFE/RL highlights mounting concern over Russian threats to the Baltic States. Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia are boosting defenses and embracing new technology, but funding uncertainty, delayed projects, and gaps in capabilities raise questions about their readiness. Baltic States Arm For Russian Threat As Leaked Letter Shows Growing Fears.

item.description: There is a harsh paradox in today’s sustainability debate.
